summary: AgencyProfileHistory tracks changes and interactions involving an agency's profile within the system.
purpose: To manage and maintain historical records of profile changes made by agency users.

workflows.name: Select Agency Profile History
steps: Execute database query to retrieve history records
Return list of agency profile history records

business_rules: Only allow access if user session is valid
validations: Verify AgencyID and UserSession are correctly set

conditions.description: Cancel data source selection if user session is null

system_behavior: User actions and profile changes are logged and retrieved from the database
exceptions: Invalid user session results in query cancellation
